description_en: Creates a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) app instance
description_zh: 调用CreateSmartAccessGatewaySoftware创建智能接入网关APP实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-smart-access-gateway-software --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 12 --auto-pay false --charge-type PREPAY --user-count 5 --data-plan 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmartAccessGatewaySoftware

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where you want to create the SAG app instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the SAG app instance. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关APP实例的购买时长，单位：月。
取值：1~9、12、24、36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically complete the payment of the order. Valid values:

true: yes
false (default): no

If you set the parameter to false, go to Billing Management to complete the payment after you call this operation. The instance is created only after you complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付智能接入网关APP实例的账单。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

如果您选择不自动支付账单，在您调用本接口后，请前往控制台的订单中心完成支付，实例才能创建成功
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the SAG app instance. Set the value to PREPAY. This value indicates that the SAG app instance is a subscription resource
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例的计费类型，取值：PREPAY，预付费。标识智能接入网关APP实例为先付费后使用的资源
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of client accounts that can be created on the SAG app instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例的客户端账号数量规格
parameters.name: user_count

parameters.help_en:
The size of the free data plan that is allocated to each client account per month. Unit: GB. Valid value: 5.

This value specifies that a free data plan of 5 GB is allocated to each client account per month
parameters.help_zh:
系统每月赠送给每个客户端账号的流量套餐规格，单位：GB。取值：5。

目前仅支持每月赠送给每个客户端账号5 GB的流量套餐
parameters.name: data_plan
